thread:
Maya (CSM): quick post-cutover sync for SecureBridge VPC onboarding. Devon flagged intermittent audit ingest failures overnight, want to capture impact and next steps.
Devon (Customer): Yup. We saw ~120 failed PUTs to securebridge-audit-prod between ~02:00-03:30 UTC. Agent logs show ServiceUnavailable 503 responses then retries. No apparent application-side retry policy changes.
Nidhi (Solutions): Can you paste the exact error and the KMS key/bucket ARNs? That helps narrow network vs crypto issues.
Devon (Customer): Error lines: `2026-03-22T02:14:07Z ERROR audit-shipper Upload failed file=logs/2026-03-22/02/14/part-12.gz error=ServiceUnavailable status=503 retry=1` KMS: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/4a5b6c7d bucket: securebridge-audit-prod-us-east-1
Sam (Security): First pass: KMS denies show AccessDenied, not 503. Check CloudTrail for KMS:Decrypt attempts and S3 5xx spikes. Also confirm Redwood shipper IAM role still present in key policy.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollout/securebridge-audit-shipper v1.4.2 completed 2026-03-22T01:40:00Z by infra-team
Maya (CSM): FYI infra applied a firewall tightening at 01:45 UTC per ticket. Devon, did you rotate keys during that window?
Devon (Customer): No primary key rotation. We rotated a secondary key earlier in week, not during cutover. Firewall rule apply is the main change at 01:45.
Nidhi (Solutions): Hypothesis: transient egress interruption during firewall rule rollout caused S3 5xx responses and shipper retries. Can you export shipper logs for 01:30-04:30 and share?
Devon (Customer): Uploaded tar: https://rwd-securebridge-shared/logs/securebridge/2026-03-22-shipper.tar.gz
Nidhi (Solutions): scanning logs now. I see retry spikes at 02:12-02:20 and a smaller spike at 03:05. Correlating with S3 metrics shows a 5xx spike 02:10-02:22 (p99 latency rose).
Sam (Security): CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt success entries at 02:10 and 03:05. No AccessDenied. Key grants intact.
Nidhi (Solutions): Firewall change was reverted at 02:25 for troubleshooting. Timeline fits transient network gating during rule rollout causing backpressure.
Maya (CSM): Impact summary for health/renewal: delayed audit delivery ~1.5h, triggered alert noise for two downstream customers. No data loss but operational visibility hit. We'll add as a renewal risk note (customer upset about monitoring noise).
Devon (Customer): Correct. We want mitigation before renewal QBR.
Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Nidhi to create a pre-cutover egress ACL + synthetic S3 upload test (owner: Solutions) 2) Infra to avoid applying hard firewall changes during peak ingest windows or use staged rules (owner: Infra) 3) Joint alert: S3 5xx >1% sustained for 10m -> paging (owner: Customer + Redwood) 4) CS to log issue in renewal risk tracker.
Nidhi (Solutions): Draft runbook snippet for synthetic check: `# synthetic upload test
curl -sS https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/securebridge-audit-prod-us-east-1/test-upload --upload-file /tmp/ping.txt || echo FAILED` Will post PR.
Sam (Security): Recommend short-lived Canary KMS grant for shipper during maintenance windows to reduce rotation impact surface. I'll add checklist to security playbook.
Devon (Customer): Can we schedule a dry-run next Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC to validate the runbook?
Maya (CSM): I'll schedule the dry-run and include Infra, Solutions, and Security. I'll also flag renewal owner to include this in QBR talking points.
ops-bot: Runbook RB-6428 created: "securebridge: audit ingest post-cutover runbook" assigned to Nidhi
Nidhi (Solutions): Following up later today with PR + results from a quick synthetic test against staging.
Sam (Security): Added KMS rotation + firewall staging checklist to internal docs.
Maya (CSM): Closing for now; reopen if further failed uploads crop up. :thumbsup:
